Summary.Name: DeepCORO-SYNTAX
Summary.Description: DeepCORO-CLIP based estimator of a modified SYNTAX score from a complete multi-view coronary angiography study. Emits continuous global, left and right scores plus four-class severity.

Mechanism.Outcome: Modified SYNTAX score (continuous) and four-class severity
Mechanism.Output: syntax: points; syntax_left / syntax_right: territory points; syntax_category: zero / 1-22 / 23-32 / >=33
Mechanism.Target_population: Adults undergoing diagnostic coronary angiography. Not validated in grafted anatomy; prior-CABG studies were excluded from development.
Mechanism.Input_data_source: Diagnostic coronary angiogram, up to 10 projections per study
Mechanism.Model_type: Deep Learning (MViT encoder + multiple-instance linear probing)

Model.Purpose: Estimate modified SYNTAX score and severity band from a whole angiographic study
Model.Output: Continuous score, territory scores, severity class

Uses_and_directions.Intended_use: Triage and consistency aid. A clinician confirms the output against the images. High negative predictive value makes it a rule-out step for intermediate-to-high complexity (>=23), not a confirmatory test.
Uses_and_directions.Not_intended_use: Autonomous scoring, treatment decisions without Heart Team review, grafted anatomy, or any use where a fully specified SYNTAX score is required.
Uses_and_directions.Directions: Submit a complete diagnostic study. Read the severity band alongside the continuous score; the two can disagree near a cut-point.

Warnings.Reference_standard: The reference is a MODIFIED SYNTAX score (16-segment, segment-based), not a core-laboratory SYNTAX score. It covers 16 of 25 segments, never records severe tortuosity, and captures none of the five total-occlusion sub-modifiers. All omissions are one-directional: the score is biased downward, most in occlusive and multivessel disease.
Warnings.Validation_status: No fully external validation. Both development cohorts contributed training data; the second-institution result is held-out internal performance. Manuscript under peer review (EuroIntervention EIJ-D-26-00383).
Warnings.Known_bias: Proportional bias persists: the model scores progressively lower than the reference as complexity rises (slope -0.168, p<0.001; -0.164, p=0.009).
Warnings.Explainability: No segment-level attribution. Attention weights indicate which projections were used, not which anatomic structures.
Warnings.Performance: CardioSYNTAX n=369: AUROC 0.97 (0.94-0.99), Se 0.86, Sp 0.93, NPV 0.98, rho 0.77, ICC 0.83, MAE 3.36. MHI held-out n=127: AUROC 0.88 (0.79-0.95), Se 0.72, Sp 0.80, NPV 0.95, rho 0.80, ICC 0.76, MAE 4.98. Versus physicians (n=171): AI accuracy 0.74, kappa 0.71; physician consensus 0.70, kappa 0.69 - comparable, not superior.
